title: 第10章 嫂子的异样
novel_title: 觉醒阴阳神功：分手后我爽麻了
content_zh:
陈阳连忙摇头，语气有些局促：“不是不是，嫂子，我不是这个意思。”

    “那就快张嘴。”宋萌萌笑着，语气不容拒绝，筷子依旧停在他嘴边。

    陈阳皱了皱眉头，心里有些不好意思，可看着宋萌萌真诚的眼神，终究还是缓缓张开了嘴巴。

    宋萌萌轻轻将饺子送进他嘴里。

    或许是真的饿坏了，陈阳嚼了两口，瞬间眼睛一亮，只觉得饺子鲜香可口，皮薄馅足，一口就吞进了肚里。

    宋萌萌见他吃得香甜，脸上露出欣慰的笑容，又连忙夹了一个饺子递了过去。

    陈阳实在过意不去，连忙说：“嫂子，真的不用了，我自己来就行，总麻烦你不好。”

    宋萌萌摆了摆手，笑意温柔：“没事，就再吃这一个，吃完你自己来。”

    陈阳无奈，只好再次张开嘴巴，又被她喂着吃了一个。

    宋萌萌这才将筷子递给陈阳，把保温餐盒推到他面前，眼神里满是宠溺。

    陈阳接过筷子，再也忍不住，大口大口地吃了起来，一连吃了好几个，嘴角都沾了点汤汁。

    宋萌萌看着他狼吞虎咽的模样，连忙递过一张纸巾，轻轻帮他擦了擦嘴角，语气带着几分嗔怪：“你慢点吃，别着急，没人跟你抢，小心噎着了。”

    陈阳嘴里塞满了饺子，含糊不清说：“嫂子，你包的饺子太好吃了，比外面卖的还香。”

    宋萌萌听了，脸颊微微泛红，眼神里闪过一丝羞涩，语气轻柔：“你要是喜欢吃，改天嫂子再做给你吃，想吃多少做多少。”

    陈阳瞥见她害羞的模样，心里也有些不好意思，连忙转移话题，放下筷子，语气坚定：“嫂子，麻烦你帮我办理出院手续，我现在就出院。”

    宋萌萌愣了一下，眉头微微皱起，语气里满是担忧：“你头还没好呢，纱布都还没拆，现在出院太冒险了吧？”

    陈阳轻轻摇了摇头，语气笃定：“没事，我自己会注意休息，在家养着也一样，在这里住着也不方便，还得担心恒哥。”

    宋萌萌看着他坚决的模样，知道劝不动他，只好点了点头：“行，那我去给你办理出院手续，你在这等着，别乱跑。”

    说完，宋萌萌转身走出病房。
content_en:
Chen Yang shook his head quickly, his tone a little awkward: "No, no, sister-in-law, that's not what I meant."

"Then open your mouth quickly." Song Mengmeng smiled, her tone not allowing for rejection, and the chopsticks remained at his mouth.

Chen Yang frowned, feeling a little embarrassed, but looking at Song Mengmeng's sincere eyes, he slowly opened his mouth.

Song Mengmeng gently put the dumpling into his mouth.

Perhaps he was really hungry. After chewing a few mouthfuls, Chen Yang's eyes suddenly lit up. He felt that the dumplings were delicious and thin, with enough filling. He swallowed them in one bite.

Seeing that he was eating deliciously, Song Mengmeng showed a happy smile on her face, and quickly picked up another dumpling and handed it over.

Chen Yang felt really sorry and said quickly: "Sister-in-law, there's really no need. I can just do it myself. It's not a good idea to bother you."

Song Mengmeng waved her hand with a gentle smile: "It's okay, just eat this one, and you can finish it yourself."

Chen Yang had no choice but to open his mouth again, and she fed him another one.

Song Mengmeng then handed the chopsticks to Chen Yang and pushed the insulated lunch box in front of him, her eyes full of doting.

Chen Yang took the chopsticks and couldn't hold back any longer. He ate with big mouthfuls. He ate several pieces in a row, and the corners of his mouth were stained with soup.

Song Mengmeng watched him wolfing down the food, and quickly handed over a tissue, gently wiping the corners of his mouth, with a bit of annoyance in her tone: "Eat slowly, don't be in a hurry, no one will compete with you, be careful of choking."

Chen Yang's mouth was full of dumplings and he said vaguely: "Sister-in-law, the dumplings you make are so delicious, they are better than those sold outside."

After hearing this, Song Mengmeng's cheeks turned slightly red, a hint of shyness flashed in her eyes, and her tone was soft: "If you like to eat, my sister-in-law will cook it for you another day. You can eat as much as you want."

Chen Yang caught a glimpse of her shy look and felt a little embarrassed. He quickly changed the subject, put down his chopsticks, and said firmly: "Sister-in-law, please help me go through the discharge procedures. I will be discharged from the hospital now."

Song Mengmeng was stunned for a moment, her brows furrowed slightly, and her tone was full of worry: "Your head is not healed yet, and the gauze has not been removed yet. Is it too risky to leave the hospital now?"

Chen Yang shook his head gently and said in a determined tone: "It's okay, I will pay attention to rest myself, and it will be the same if I raise him at home. It is not convenient to live here, and I have to worry about Brother Heng."

Song Mengmeng looked at his resolute look and knew that she couldn't persuade him, so she nodded: "Okay, then I will go through the discharge procedures for you. You wait here and don't run around."

After saying that, Song Mengmeng turned around and walked out of the ward.
